intro:
Can you complete
the beach date photo?
description:
Enjoy a feel-good photo puzzle built around a heart-fluttering beach date with your crush.

Look closely at a picture whose parts are facing every which way, then rotate them back into the right direction. With simple, intuitive play, you’ll bring one complete photo back to life.

How to play:
・Check the direction of the photo parts
・Give each part a quick turn
・Line up every direction and complete the picture

As you enjoy summery date scenes by the blue sea and sandy shore, your powers of observation and quick inspiration are put to the test.

Easy to play in short bursts, it is just right for a quick break or a spare moment. It is also a great pick if you like relaxing puzzles or want to take your time completing each photo on your own.

Finish the special date scene waiting on the beach with your own hands!
